regression.interpretation: Rates are retrospective synthetic regression outcomes, not accuracy or biological certification. Final exclusion and own-baseline-retain conversion are separate. Bystander denominators count repeated target/slice pairs, not independent slices. Failed/pending variants remain in planned denominators.

historical_comparison.attribution: includes raw-reextraction and historical-policy changes, not only the new resolver

limitations: Retrospective previously inspected regression cohort, not independent validation.
No expert biological ground truth; native changes cannot estimate accuracy.
Two-sided reference required; endpoints and uniform whole-series deterioration remain evidence-limited.
